_readme: Master profile for Tailor. Achievements are stored as parts, not finished sentences, so the app can recombine them for each job description. Syntax is in tailor/README.md. Source: the site's Experience page and case studies as of the November 2026 corrections (8th CPC volumes and team, GHCI audit wording, Infosys figures, AI work), plus dossier-confirmed EY, UST and TCS detail. Anything still marked verify:true is from an older resume and not yet reconfirmed.

summary._how: The summary is built only from these broad lines, never from individual achievements. Each line carries tags; the app picks the ones that best fit the JD's skills that your record backs up.

approach.text: Works across ministries, vendors and technical teams that do not report to one another, and plans around what cannot move: a statute, a date or a security audit.
Started in software engineering and blockchain architecture, so architecture, data models and security findings get reviewed directly rather than relayed.
Scopes AI into products where it helps, with a named person responsible for every decision.
Comfortable carrying product ownership and Scrum responsibilities alongside project management.
Fixes how the work is organised before cutting cost, and measures results rather than deliverables.
